parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description: The type of the policy. Valid values: `System` and `Custom`.

parameters.name: VersionId
parameters.description: The ID of the policy version.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram get-policy-version --policy-type Custom --policy-name OSS-Administrator --version-id v3 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ram GetPolicyVersion --region cn-hangzhou --VersionId v3 --PolicyType Custom --PolicyName 'OSS-Administrator'
